moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: The last long weekend of summer for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland arrives on Monday, August 31st.

angles.name: Summer's Last Hurrah
angles.copy: Who's making the most of the August Bank Holiday weekend? It's the last long one before Christmas!

angles.name: Bank Holiday Plans
angles.copy: Got big plans for the August Bank Holiday? Three-day weekend incoming for England, Wales & Northern Ireland!

moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The new Premier League season begins this Friday, August 21st, with Arsenal hosting newly-promoted Coventry City.

angles.name: Season Starter
angles.copy: It's back! The Premier League 2026/27 season kicks off this Friday. Are you ready for the drama?

angles.name: Opening Weekend
angles.copy: Arsenal vs Coventry City starts the Premier League weekend on Friday. Who are you backing for the opening fixtures?

moments.title: Wrexham in Championship Action
moments.blurb: Welsh club Wrexham plays their first home Championship match of the season this Friday, August 28th, against Birmingham City.

angles.name: Wrexham Home Opener
angles.copy: A huge night for Wrexham! They host Birmingham City this Friday in their first Championship home game. Good luck, lads!

angles.name: Welsh Football Pride
angles.copy: Wrexham flying the flag for Wales in the Championship! Get behind them this Friday as they take on Birmingham City.

moments.title: All Points East Festival Begins
moments.blurb: London's All Points East festival kicks off this Friday, August 21st, running until August 30th in Victoria Park with headliners like Lorde, Tyler, The Creator and Deftones.

angles.name: London Festival Vibes
angles.copy: All Points East returns to Victoria Park this weekend! Who are you excited to see? Lorde, Tyler, The Creator, Deftones and more!

angles.name: Festival Lineup
angles.copy: London is buzzing! All Points East kicks off Friday with a massive lineup through to August 30th. Get your festival face on!

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals Weekend
moments.blurb: The iconic Reading and Leeds Festivals take place from August 28th-30th, attracting thousands of music fans across two sites.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Less than 10 days until Reading & Leeds! Who's packing their wellies and getting ready for the ultimate festival weekend?

angles.name: Reading or Leeds?
angles.copy: Are you Team Reading or Team Leeds this year? The biggest festival weekend of the summer is almost here!

moments.title: Creamfields Festival Approaches
moments.blurb: The UK's premier dance music festival, Creamfields, takes over Cheshire from August 27th-29th.

angles.name: Dance Festival Energy
angles.copy: Creamfields is almost here! Get ready for three days of the biggest names in dance music, starting August 27th.

angles.name: Cheshire Calling
angles.copy: Who's heading to Creamfields next week? The countdown is on for the UK's biggest electronic music event!

moments.title: Green Man Festival Underway
moments.blurb: Wales' largest independent music and arts festival, Green Man, runs from August 20th-23rd in the stunning Brecon Beacons.

angles.name: Welsh Festival Spirit
angles.copy: Green Man Festival is ON! Who's soaking up the music, art, and incredible atmosphere in the Brecon Beacons this weekend?

angles.name: Brecon Beats
angles.copy: From music to comedy, literature to science, Green Man Festival in Wales has it all. What's been your highlight so far?

moments.title: Official Singles Chart Update
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold strong at Number 1 with 'Rein Me In', while Madonna & Kylie Minogue make a splash with 'Love Sensation' debuting at Number 8.

angles.name: Chart Toppers
angles.copy: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean still ruling the Official Singles Chart! Are you loving 'Rein Me In' at Number 1?

angles.name: Pop Royalty Collab
angles.copy: Madonna and Kylie Minogue together in the Top 10! 'Love Sensation' is the chart entry everyone's talking about. Iconic!

moments.title: The Voice UK is Back!
moments.blurb: The Voice UK returns for a new series this Saturday, August 22nd, on ITV1, featuring a refreshed coaching lineup and new twists, including Kelly Rowland joining as a coach.

angles.name: Saturday Night TV
angles.copy: Your Saturday night TV just got better! The Voice UK is back this weekend with new coaches and new talent. Who's tuning in?

angles.name: New Coach Alert
angles.copy: Welcome to The Voice UK, Kelly Rowland! The Destiny's Child star joins the coaching panel this Saturday on ITV1.

moments.title: Ian Gillan Turns 81
moments.blurb: Today, August 19th, marks the 81st birthday of Ian Gillan, the legendary lead singer of rock band Deep Purple.

angles.name: Rock Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 81st Birthday to Deep Purple's iconic frontman, Ian Gillan! What's your favourite Deep Purple track?

angles.name: Celebrating a Voice
angles.copy: The voice of 'Smoke On The Water' and so many more! Celebrating Ian Gillan's 81st birthday today. Rock on!

moments.title: John Deacon Turns 75
moments.blurb: Queen's bassist and songwriter, John Deacon, celebrates his 75th birthday today, August 19th.

angles.name: Queen Bassist Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 75th Birthday to the incredible John Deacon of Queen! Responsible for some massive hits!

angles.name: Songwriting Genius
angles.copy: From 'Another One Bites the Dust' to 'I Want to Break Free', celebrating Queen's John Deacon on his 75th birthday today!

moments.title: Joey Tempest Turns 63
moments.blurb: Joey Tempest, the charismatic lead singer of Swedish rock band Europe, celebrates his 63rd birthday today, August 19th.

angles.name: It's the Final Countdown...
angles.copy: Happy 63rd Birthday to Europe's Joey Tempest! Get ready to sing along to 'The Final Countdown' all day!

angles.name: 80s Rock Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating the birthday of Joey Tempest, frontman of Europe! What's your favourite power ballad or anthem from the band?

moments.title: Christina Perri Turns 40
moments.blurb: American singer-songwriter Christina Perri, known for hits like 'Jar of Hearts' and 'A Thousand Years', celebrates her 40th birthday today, August 19th.

angles.name: Birthday Wishes
angles.copy: Happy 40th Birthday to the amazing Christina Perri! Which of her beautiful songs is your favourite?

angles.name: A Thousand Years of Song
angles.copy: Celebrating Christina Perri's 40th today! Her music has soundtracked so many moments. What's your most loved track?

moments.title: Lee Ann Womack Turns 60
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning country music star Lee Ann Womack, known for hits like 'I Hope You Dance', celebrates her 60th birthday today, August 19th.

angles.name: Country Star's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 60th Birthday to the incredible country artist Lee Ann Womack! What's your favourite of her songs?

angles.name: Hope You Dance
angles.copy: Celebrating the voice behind 'I Hope You Dance'! Happy 60th Birthday to Lee Ann Womack today. A true country legend.
